meta.report: McPherson, E. Gregory; van Doorn, Natalie S.; Peper, Paula J. 2016. Urban tree database and allometric equations. Gen. Tech. Rep. PSW-GTR-253. Albany, CA: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Forest Service, Pacific Southwest Research Station. https://doi.org/10.2737/PSW-GTR-253

meta.units: DBH in centimetres; crown diameter (crown) and total tree height (height) in metres; ageDbh: DBH (cm) from years since planting
meta.equations: TS4_Growth_eqn_forms.csv: lin a+bx; quad a+bx+cx^2; cub a+bx+cx^2+dx^3; quart +ex^4; loglogw1..4 exp(a+b ln(ln(x+1)) + w mse/2) and expow1..4 exp(a+bx + w mse/2) with mse = c and w = 1, sqrt(x), x, x^2; prediction clamped to [min, max] (the equation's application range) and DBH to dbhCm (the species' measured range)
meta.rule: A list species is sized with the database record of the same species in NoCalC (Berkeley, CA: San Francisco's region), else the same species in the nearest other region (order: regionOrder), else the genus (its most-measured species) in that order, else for a Myrtaceae genus Melaleuca quinquenervia (SoCalC), for a conifer genus Pinus radiata (NoCalC), else the median over the NoCalC broadleaf species (broadleaf); palms and palm-like monocots are not sized.

equations.common: coastal live oak; California live oak
